Hi Jake / procurement team,

Thanks for the conversation last week. Attached is a short renewal summary and a draft amendment that would move your renewal to a single consolidated invoice flow and Net30 payment terms (amendment_net30_draft.docx attached). Key points: 
- Renewal: 500k tokens/month committed capacity (annual) across three Harborlane sub-accounts.
- Ask: consolidate billing under a single payor (one PO) to simplify ops and reduce duplicate invoices.
- Payment terms requested: Net30 on consolidated invoice.
- Required from Harborlane: payor legal name and EIN / W-9 for the entity that will be the invoiced party; any internal PO number(s) that should be referenced on invoices.

If you can share the W-9/EIN for the payor and confirm the PO number to reference we can:
1) Produce a sample consolidated invoice showing line-item allocations per sub-account,
2) Send a DocuSign amendment to switch the renewal to single-payor Net30, and,
3) Update the billing contact to your preferred mail-to for invoices (PDF + remit instructions).

I've cc'd Marissa from Billing & Neha from Renewals so we can move quickly once we have the payor docs.

Attachments: redwood_renewal_summary.pdf, amendment_net30_draft.docx

Best,

Sofia — thanks for the clear note and the docs. A few quick items from our side: 
- We are open to a single PO/payor but need to confirm tax treatment across our subsidiaries. Can you show a sample invoice that maps charges back to each Harborlane sub-account? That will help our internal chargeback.
- We've attached the W-9 for Harborlane Holdings, Inc. (Harborlane_EIN_W9.pdf). The payor we prefer is Harborlane Holdings, EIN 12-3456789.
- Our procurement team typically needs the Redwood legal entity and EIN on the invoice. Please confirm the legal payee name and EIN you will use.
- Net30 is fine from our side, but procurement will need the DocuSign amendment routed to Lydia (cc'd) for sign-off.

Two small constraints: 1) our ERP requires that each invoice references at least one internal PO number. Can you accept a single blanket PO that lists the three sub-account IDs on the PO header? 2) We usually get invoices via procurement@harborlane.com and remit to our AP portal.

Thanks — attaching the W-9. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.
